# Brief — the idea (rev. 3 after idea review #3, re-review)

## Task as I read it
A new model can be run on only k of N benchmarks; a historical model × benchmark matrix (cells missing) is available. Choose the k benchmarks and infer the other N−k scores as accurately as possible; say how large k must be, and under which data conditions that holds. Deliverable: a venue-grade paper (ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS) plus code; claims rest on real leaderboard matrices and a theory checked against data.

## Question
**Q.** Given a historical score matrix, which k benchmarks should be run for a new model, how should the rest be inferred, and how large must k be for the error to reach the level the low-rank structure allows? Under which data conditions does the answer hold?

## What the contribution is (and is not)
The machinery is classical: item selection by A-/D-optimal design for a latent trait vector (multidimensional computerized adaptive testing, Mulder & van der Linden 2009), cold-start active learning for matrix factorisation (Rashid 2002, Golbandi 2011, Houlsby 2014), probabilistic PCA, greedy subset selection with submodularity-ratio guarantees. **I do not claim a new selection method.** The contribution is: (i) the empirical answer on real leaderboard matrices under the protocol that matches the use (whole new models held out, by group; selection fit on others only); (ii) a sufficiency rule k*(ε) tied to the spectrum of the matrix, with its misfit term made explicit; (iii) the **scope map**: where the answer holds and where it never reaches the floor (extrapolation to new families/strongest models, sparse coverage, small M, saturated scores, task granularity), including a misspecification ladder on synthetic data on which real matrices are placed.

## Model and selection
- y_{mj} = μ_j + v_jᵀ z_m + ε_{mj}, ε~N(0,σ_j²) on standardised scores, fitted by EM on observed cells (probabilistic PCA/FA with missing data); transform/link as a sensitivity variant.
- New model: posterior of z given the run set S. Selection objective with a **fixed target**: F(S) = tr(V Σ_post(S) Vᵀ) over all benchmarks (or a weighted version / the unrun-only variant; compared empirically). Greedy; the Das–Kempe / Bian et al. guarantee is reported but may be vacuous at low noise, so greedy is checked against exhaustive search (small N) and swap/local search. Posterior covariance is independent of y, so selection is an offline subset problem per run-set restriction. Cost-aware variant (gain per cost, equal-cost random comparator) only if a real cost source exists (MTEB `evaluation_time`, to be confirmed), else dropped or a stated proxy.

## Theory (stated with assumptions; each checked)
- **T1 (risk decomposition).** Under the model with *known* parameters: E err_j(S) = σ_j² + v_jᵀ(I + V_SᵀΣ_S⁻¹V_S)⁻¹v_j. With parameters estimated from M models there is an additional estimation term, predicted to scale ~1/M. Empirical risk(k) = residual floor + design term(k) + misfit(k); the misfit term is reported on real data.
- **T2 (shape of the curve).** Two regimes, stated before results: with separated factors (eigenvalues ≫ σ²) a knee near effective rank r; with decaying spectrum a gradual closure and ~1/k decay whose constant depends on the incoherence of the loadings. Effective rank is defined *before* looking at results (parallel analysis, eigenvalues above the noise edge, CV-selected rank; sensitivity to imputation reported). k*(ε) = smallest k whose predicted design term ≤ ε, in raw score points as well as standardised units.

# Baselines and methods the study must be compared with (for `experiment-repo`)

Protocol (fixed by the idea; analysis decides how to run): for each held-out model m (leave-one-model-out; also leave-family-out and extrapolation splits), everything — standardisation, factor model, selection — is fit on the other models only. m's observed row is revealed at the k selected benchmarks (restricted to those m actually has); predict the rest of m's *observed* cells; score on those. Report mean over held-out models with a bootstrap-over-models CI, and paired differences between methods.

**Selection rules (S)**
- S0 random-k (many draws; report mean and spread — this is the main comparator, not a straw man)
- S1 most-observed / popularity (maximum coverage)
- S2 highest-variance benchmarks
- S3 greedy forward selection by cross-validated error on training models (wrapper; Das–Kempe)
- S4 pivoted-QR / leverage-score column subset selection (Boutsidis 2009)
- S5 clustering of benchmarks (k-medoids on correlation distance), one per cluster
- S6 **proposed**: greedy Bayesian V-optimal design on a probabilistic factor model; cost-aware variant (gain per unit cost)
- S7 adaptive: decision-tree/kNN interview (Golbandi 2011 style) — tests *misspecification gains* of adaptivity (a different model from PPCA). Adaptive-vs-batch under the *same* PPCA posterior is a unit test (must agree to numerical precision), not an experiment.
- S8 exhaustive oracle best subset where C(N,k) is feasible (Open LLM LB N=6, HELM Lite N=10) to bound greedy's gap

**Inference rules (P)**
- P0 benchmark mean (no information); P1 benchmark mean + model offset (mean of observed standardised scores; the "general factor" baseline)
- P2 ridge/linear regression on the selected benchmarks (per target) with missing training cells handled by pairwise/EM
- P3 kNN over training models (collaborative filtering), P4 iterative-SVD / Soft-Impute (Mazumder 2010), P5 probabilistic PCA/FA posterior mean (proposed inference, Tipping–Bishop), P6 PCA capability-space regression with sigmoid/link as in observational scaling laws (Ruan 2024) and Sloth (Polo 2024) where a link function is needed (bounded scores)
- Must be run as published or documented adaptation; report any that cannot be run as published back to `idea-repo` via an issue.

rows, bad = [], []
for n in names:

    except Exception:

    el = m.eval_langs

                     domains="|".join(m.domains or []), superseded_by=getattr(m, "superseded_by", None)))
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
df.to_parquet(os.path.join(out, "task_meta.parquet"))
print("mteb", mteb.__version__, "found", len(df), "not found", len(bad), bad)
print(df.type.value_counts().head(12)); print(df.modalities.value_counts())

"""Cell construction for the MTEB matrix, as fixed in prereg/PREREG.md (rules R1-R6).
build_cells(raw, meta, task_meta) -> long table (model, task, score_pts) with one revision per model."""
import re, numpy as np, pandas as pd

SPLIT_PRIORITY = ["test", "test.full", "validation", "validation.full", "dev", "devtest", "default"]  # 'train' never used

def norm_org(org):
    o = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", org.lower())
    return ORG_ALIAS.get(o, o)

# spelling-level aliases only (same organisation written differently); fixed before any result
ORG_ALIAS = {"bytedanceseed": "bytedance", "baai": "baai", "jinaai": "jinaai", "sbert": "sentencetransformers"}

def model_key(model_dir):
    return model_dir

def pick_revisions(raw, meta, text_tasks):
    """R1: one revision directory per model directory: the one with most distinct text-task files;
    ties -> latest release_date in its model_meta, then lexicographically smallest directory name."""
    t = raw[raw.task.isin(text_tasks)]
    cnt = t.groupby(["model_dir", "rev_dir"]).file.nunique().rename("n_files").reset_index()
    cnt = cnt.merge(meta[["model_dir", "rev_dir", "release_date"]], on=["model_dir", "rev_dir"], how="left")
    cnt["rd"] = cnt.release_date.fillna("")
    cnt = cnt.sort_values(["model_dir", "n_files", "rd", "rev_dir"], ascending=[True, False, False, True])
    return cnt.groupby("model_dir").head(1)[["model_dir", "rev_dir", "n_files"]]

def build_cells(raw, meta, task_meta, log=None):
    log = log if log is not None else {}
    tm = task_meta.set_index("task")
    # R2 text-only tasks (modality exactly {text}); tasks unknown to the mteb metadata are dropped
    text_tasks = set(tm.index[tm.modalities == "text"])
    log["raw_models"] = raw.model_dir.nunique(); log["raw_tasks"] = raw.task.nunique()
    log["text_tasks"] = len(text_tasks & set(raw.task))
    rev = pick_revisions(raw, meta, text_tasks)
    r = raw.merge(rev[["model_dir", "rev_dir"]], on=["model_dir", "rev_dir"])
    r = r[r.task.isin(text_tasks) & r.main_score.notna()].copy()
    log["models_after_revision_pick"] = r.model_dir.nunique()
    # R3 split: first split in SPLIT_PRIORITY that is in the task's declared eval_splits and present for the model
    decl = {t: set(tm.at[t, "eval_splits"].split("|")) for t in text_tasks}
    r = r[r.split.isin(SPLIT_PRIORITY)]
    r = r[[s in decl[t] for s, t in zip(r.split, r.task)]]
    pr = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(SPLIT_PRIORITY)}
    r["pr"] = r.split.map(pr)
    best = r.groupby(["model_dir", "task"]).pr.transform("min")
    r = r[r.pr == best]
    log["cells_after_split"] = r.groupby(["model_dir", "task"]).ngroups
    # R4 task version: dataset_revision must equal the task's modal dataset_revision (over models)
    dr = r.drop_duplicates(["model_dir", "task", "dataset_revision"])
    modal_dr = dr.groupby("task").dataset_revision.agg(lambda s: s.value_counts().index[0])
    n_before = r.groupby(["model_dir", "task"]).ngroups
    r = r[r.dataset_revision == r.task.map(modal_dr)]
    log["cells_after_dataset_revision"] = r.groupby(["model_dir", "task"]).ngroups
    # R5 subsets: canonical subset set of a task = its modal subset set over models; a cell is kept iff the
    # model reports a superset of it, and the score is the mean of main_score over the canonical subsets
    ss = r.groupby(["model_dir", "task"]).hf_subset.agg(lambda s: frozenset(s))
    modal_ss = ss.groupby("task").agg(lambda s: s.value_counts().index[0])
    keep = {k for k, v in ss.items() if v >= modal_ss[k[1]]}
    r["_k"] = list(zip(r.model_dir, r.task))
    r = r[r._k.isin(keep)]
    r = r[[h in modal_ss[t] for h, t in zip(r.hf_subset, r.task)]]
    log["cells_after_subsets"] = r.groupby(["model_dir", "task"]).ngroups
    cells = r.groupby(["model_dir", "task"]).agg(score=("main_score", "mean"), split=("split", "first"),
                                                 n_sub=("hf_subset", "nunique"), eval_time=("eval_time", "mean"))

usage: python 03_build_matrix.py <work_dir> <repo_data_dir>
Outputs: <work_dir>/cells_all.parquet (all cells after R1-R5), <repo_data_dir>/matrix_long.parquet (final),
         <repo_data_dir>/models.csv, <repo_data_dir>/tasks.csv, <repo_data_dir>/coverage_filter.csv"""
import sys, os, json, pandas as pd, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from mteb_cells import build_cells, norm_org

W, D = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
os.makedirs(D, exist_ok=True)
raw = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(W, "cells_raw.parquet")); meta = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(W, "model_meta.parquet"))
tm = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(W, "task_meta.parquet"))
cells, log = build_cells(raw, meta, tm)
# R6 dedup: model dirs whose meta name is identical (case-insensitive) keep the one with most cells; `_(...)` config variants dropped
m1 = meta.drop_duplicates("model_dir").set_index("model_dir")
cnt = cells.groupby("model_dir").size()
nm = m1.meta_name.str.lower().reindex(cnt.index)
dropv = [m for m in cnt.index if "_(" in m]
dups = pd.DataFrame({"n": cnt, "nm": nm}).dropna().sort_values("n", ascending=False)
dropd = list(dups[dups.nm.duplicated()].index)
log["dedup_dropped_variants"] = len(dropv); log["dedup_dropped_samename"] = len(set(dropd) - set(dropv))
cells = cells[~cells.model_dir.isin(set(dropv) | set(dropd))]
rows = [dict(step="R1-R5 cells (text tasks, one revision/model, split, dataset revision, subsets)",
             models=cells.model_dir.nunique(), tasks=cells.task.nunique(), cells=len(cells))]
# R7 coverage filter: tasks observed for >= TT models, models with >= TM tasks, iterated to a fixed point
TT, TM = 50, 30
c = cells
it = 0
while True:
    n0 = len(c)
    tc = c.groupby("task").model_dir.nunique(); c = c[c.task.isin(tc.index[tc >= TT])]
    rows.append(dict(step=f"iter {it}: tasks with >= {TT} models", models=c.model_dir.nunique(), tasks=c.task.nunique(), cells=len(c)))
    mc = c.groupby("model_dir").task.nunique(); c = c[c.model_dir.isin(mc.index[mc >= TM])]
    rows.append(dict(step=f"iter {it}: models with >= {TM} tasks", models=c.model_dir.nunique(), tasks=c.task.nunique(), cells=len(c)))
    it += 1
    if len(c) == n0: break
cov = pd.DataFrame(rows); cov.to_csv(os.path.join(D, "coverage_filter.csv"), index=False)
c = c.reset_index(drop=True)
M, N = c.model_dir.nunique(), c.task.nunique()
print(cov.to_string()); print("FINAL", M, N, len(c), "density", len(c) / M / N)
# models table: org group (R-group), release date, run-set size
mods = pd.DataFrame({"model": sorted(c.model_dir.unique())})
mods["org"] = [norm_org(m.split("__")[0]) for m in mods.model]
mods["release_date"] = mods.model.map(m1.release_date)
mods["n_parameters"] = mods.model.map(m1.n_parameters)
mods["runset"] = mods.model.map(c.groupby("model_dir").size())
mods.to_csv(os.path.join(D, "models.csv"), index=False)
tasks = pd.DataFrame({"task": sorted(c.task.unique())}).merge(tm[["task", "type", "n_langs", "domains"]], on="task")
tasks["n_models"] = tasks.task.map(c.groupby("task").size())
tasks.to_csv(os.path.join(D, "tasks.csv"), index=False)
c.rename(columns={"model_dir": "model"}).to_parquet(os.path.join(D, "matrix_long.parquet"))
json.dump(dict(log=log, M=M, N=N, cells=len(c), n_groups=mods.org.nunique(), type_counts=tasks.type.value_counts().to_dict()),

- **R1 one revision per model.** Within a model directory keep the revision directory with the most distinct text-task files; ties -> latest

- **R4 task version.** A cell is kept only if its `dataset_revision` equals the task's modal `dataset_revision` over models.
- **R5 subsets/languages.** The task's canonical subset set is its modal set of `hf_subset` names over models; a cell is kept iff the model reports a
  superset of it; its score is the mean of `main_score` over the canonical subsets (languages averaged). `mteb_version` of the producing run is
  NOT controlled (stated limitation; sensitivity is a secondary analysis).
- **R6 dedup.** Drop config variants (`_(` in the directory name, e.g. `_(output_dtype=int8)`); of model directories with the same lower-cased

"""Factor analysis with missing data (EM), posterior for a new row, and the T1 risk terms.
Model (standardised scores): y_mj = mu_j + v_j' z_m + e_mj,  z ~ N(0, I_r),  e ~ N(0, psi_j).
All arrays: Y (M x N) with NaN for missing; mask = ~isnan(Y)."""
import numpy as np

PSI_FLOOR = 1e-2

def _estep(Y, mask, mu, V, psi):
    """posterior mean (M x r) and covariance (M x r x r) of z_m given observed cells."""
    M, N = Y.shape; r = V.shape[1]
    VV = (V[:, :, None] * V[:, None, :]).reshape(N, r * r)
    prec = np.eye(r)[None] + ((mask / psi[None, :]) @ VV).reshape(M, r, r)
    cov = np.linalg.inv(prec)
    R = np.where(mask, (np.nan_to_num(Y) - mu[None, :]) / psi[None, :], 0.0)
    mean = np.einsum("mab,mb->ma", cov, R @ V)
    return mean, cov

def fit_fa(Y, r, n_iter=300, tol=1e-6, seed=0, init=None):
    """EM for factor analysis with missing cells. Y standardised (columns ~ mean 0). Returns dict(mu, V, psi, ll_trace)."""
    mask = ~np.isnan(Y); M, N = Y.shape
    Y0 = np.where(mask, Y, 0.0)
    cnt = mask.sum(0).clip(min=1)
    if init is None:
        mu = Y0.sum(0) / cnt
        Yc = np.where(mask, Y - mu, 0.0)
        U, s, Vt = np.linalg.svd(Yc, full_matrices=False)
        V = (Vt[:r].T * (s[:r] / np.sqrt(M))) + 0.0
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed); V = V + 1e-3 * rng.standard_normal(V.shape)
        res = np.where(mask, Yc - (U[:, :r] * s[:r]) @ Vt[:r], 0.0)
        psi = np.maximum((res ** 2).sum(0) / cnt, PSI_FLOOR)
    else:
        mu, V, psi = init["mu"].copy(), init["V"][:, :r].copy(), init["psi"].copy()
    prev = -np.inf; trace = []
    for it in range(n_iter):
        mean, cov = _estep(Y, mask, mu, V, psi)
        # sufficient statistics with augmented z~ = [z; 1]
        Ezz = cov + mean[:, :, None] * mean[:, None, :]
        A = np.zeros((M, r + 1, r + 1)); A[:, :r, :r] = Ezz; A[:, :r, r] = mean; A[:, r, :r] = mean; A[:, r, r] = 1.0
        S = (mask.astype(float).T @ A.reshape(M, -1)).reshape(N, r + 1, r + 1)       # per benchmark
        Zt = np.concatenate([mean, np.ones((M, 1))], 1)
        B = np.einsum("mj,ma->ja", Y0, Zt)                                           # N x (r+1)
        S = S + 1e-8 * np.eye(r + 1)[None]
        theta = np.linalg.solve(S, B[:, :, None])[:, :, 0]
        V, mu = theta[:, :r], theta[:, r]
        quad = np.einsum("ja,jab,jb->j", theta, S, theta)
        sq = (Y0 ** 2).sum(0)
        psi = np.maximum((sq - 2 * (theta * B).sum(1) + quad) / cnt, PSI_FLOOR)
        # observed-data negative residual proxy for convergence: mean log psi weighted
        ll = -0.5 * (cnt * np.log(psi)).sum() / mask.sum()
        trace.append(ll)
        if abs(ll - prev) < tol * (1 + abs(ll)) and it > 5: break
        prev = ll
    return dict(mu=mu, V=V, psi=psi, n_iter=it + 1, ll=trace)

def posterior_row(fit, idx, y):
    """posterior mean (r,) and covariance (r x r) of z for a new row with observed benchmark idx and standardised values y."""
    V, mu, psi = fit["V"], fit["mu"], fit["psi"]
    r = V.shape[1]
    if len(idx) == 0:
        return np.zeros(r), np.eye(r)
    Vo = V[idx] / np.sqrt(psi[idx])[:, None]
    P = np.eye(r) + Vo.T @ Vo
    cov = np.linalg.inv(P)
    mean = cov @ (Vo.T @ ((y - mu[idx]) / np.sqrt(psi[idx])))
    return mean, cov

def predict_row(fit, idx, y):
    m, _ = posterior_row(fit, idx, y)
    return fit["mu"] + fit["V"] @ m

def complete(Y, fit):
    """EM-FA conditional-mean completion of a training matrix."""
    mask = ~np.isnan(Y)
    mean, _ = _estep(Y, mask, fit["mu"], fit["V"], fit["psi"])

def load_matrix(data_dir):
    d = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(data_dir, "matrix_long.parquet"))
    mods = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(data_dir, "models.csv")); tasks = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(data_dir, "tasks.csv"))
    models = list(mods.model); tnames = list(tasks.task)
    mi = {m: i for i, m in enumerate(models)}; ti = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(tnames)}
    Y = np.full((len(models), len(tnames)), np.nan)
    Y[d.model.map(mi).values, d.task.map(ti).values] = d.score.values
    et = np.full_like(Y, np.nan); et[d.model.map(mi).values, d.task.map(ti).values] = d.eval_time.values
    return Y, mods, tasks, et

def group_folds(groups, n_folds, seed):
    """assign groups to folds greedily by size (largest first, to the currently smallest fold; ties broken by seeded order)."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    g = pd.Series(groups); sizes = g.value_counts()
    order = sorted(sizes.index, key=lambda x: (-sizes[x], rng.random()))
    load = np.zeros(n_folds); fold_of = {}
    for o in order:
        f = int(np.argmin(load + 1e-6 * rng.random(n_folds))); fold_of[o] = f; load[f] += sizes[o]
    return np.array([fold_of[x] for x in groups])

    M = len(mods); groups = mods.org.values
    out = {}
    fo = group_folds(groups, 10, seed)
    out["G"] = [(f, np.where(fo != f)[0], np.where(fo == f)[0]) for f in range(10)]
    dt = pd.to_datetime(mods.release_date, errors="coerce")
    q = dt.quantile(0.70)
    tr = np.where(dt.notna() & (dt <= q))[0]; te = np.where(dt.notna() & (dt > q))[0]
    out["T"] = [(0, tr, te)]

    """additive fit y_mj = mu_j + a_m by alternating LS on all observed cells; used only to assign the split."""
    mask = ~np.isnan(Y); a = np.zeros(Y.shape[0]); mu = np.nanmean(Y, 0)

"""Per-fold state (stage A): standardisation, FA fits for all ranks on the training models, inner group-CV rank choice

import os, sys, pickle, numpy as np, pandas as pd

from common import *
from fa import fit_fa, posterior_row

def loo_predictions(fit, idx, y):
    """leave-one-benchmark-out predictions (standardised) for every observed cell of one row, via a rank-1 downdate."""
    V, mu, psi = fit["V"], fit["mu"], fit["psi"]; r = V.shape[1]
    A = V[idx] / np.sqrt(psi[idx])[:, None]; e = (y - mu[idx]) / np.sqrt(psi[idx])
    P = np.eye(r) + A.T @ A; C = np.linalg.inv(P); b = A.T @ e
    Ca = A @ C                                   # n x r  (C a_j)
    q = np.einsum("jr,jr->j", Ca, A)             # a_j' C a_j
    bj = b[None] - A * e[:, None]
    z = bj @ C + Ca * ((Ca @ bj.T).diagonal() / (1 - q))[:, None] * 0 
    # exact Sherman-Morrison: P_j^{-1} bj = C bj + C a (a' C bj)/(1 - a'Ca)
    Cb = bj @ C                                   # C symmetric
    z = Cb + Ca * (np.einsum("jr,jr->j", A, Cb) / (1 - q))[:, None]
    return mu[idx] + np.einsum("jr,jr->j", V[idx], z)

def inner_scores(Ztr, groups_tr, ranks, k_list, rng, n_draws=2):
    """inner group-CV squared error (standardised) for each (rank, reveal) where reveal in k_list or 'loo'.
    Also returns per-task LOO squared errors (standardised) for floors, per rank."""
    n = Ztr.shape[0]; fo = inner_group_folds(groups_tr)
    mask = ~np.isnan(Ztr)
    score = {(r, k): [] for r in ranks for k in k_list + ["loo"]}
    loo_err = {r: [[] for _ in range(Ztr.shape[1])] for r in ranks}
    for f in np.unique(fo):
        tr = np.where(fo != f)[0]; va = np.where(fo == f)[0]
        for r in ranks:
            fit = fit_fa(Ztr[tr], r)
            for m in va:
                obs = np.where(mask[m])[0]
                if len(obs) < 2: continue
                yv = Ztr[m]
                for k in k_list:
                    for _ in range(n_draws):
                        S = rng.choice(obs, min(k, len(obs) - 1), replace=False)
                        T = np.setdiff1d(obs, S)

    return avg, loo_err

def build_state(Y, mods, split_name, fold, train, test, seed=SEED, ranks=RANKS, k_list=K_GRID):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 1000 * hash(split_name) % 997 + fold)

    fits = {r: fit_fa(Ztr, r) for r in sorted(set(best_rank.values()))}

import numpy as np

    o = np.lexsort((cand, -cover[cand])); return cand[o[:k]]

    o = np.lexsort((cand, -rawsd[cand])); return cand[o[:k]]

def s6_greedy(fit, cand, k, target=None, cost=None):
    """greedy Bayesian V-optimal design: maximise the reduction of tr(V Sigma_post V') (target: all N benchmarks, or the
    benchmark index set `target`); with `cost`, maximise gain per unit cost. Sherman-Morrison gains."""
    V, psi = fit["V"], fit["psi"]; r = V.shape[1]

    G = Vt.T @ Vt

    Sig = np.eye(r); chosen = []; avail = np.ones(len(cand), bool)
    for _ in range(min(k, len(cand))):
        SA = A @ Sig
        den = 1.0 + np.einsum("jr,jr->j", SA, A)
        gain = np.einsum("jr,jr->j", SA @ G, SA) / den
        if cost is not None: gain = gain / cost[cand]

        j = int(np.argmax(gain)); chosen.append(j); avail[j] = False
        s = SA[j]; Sig = Sig - np.outer(s, s) / den[j]

def s4_pivqr(Xc, cand, k):
    """pivoted QR column subset selection (Businger-Golub; Boutsidis et al. 2009 baseline) on the completed training matrix"""
    _, _, piv = qr(Xc[:, cand], mode="economic", pivoting=True)
    return cand[piv[:k]]

    n = D.shape[0]

        d = D[:, med].min(1); p = d ** 2; p = p / p.sum() if p.sum() > 0 else np.ones(n) / n
        med.append(int(rng.choice(n, p=p)))

"""C1 structure: spectrum of the filtered matrix, three effective-rank estimators (prereg G), CV error vs rank, coverage matrix.
usage: python 09_structure.py <data_dir> <work_dir> <out_dir>"""
import os, sys, glob, pickle, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd

    Zf = np.where(mk, Zm, 0.0); mf = mk.astype(float)

    den = np.sqrt(np.maximum(sxx - sx ** 2 / np.maximum(n, 1), 1e-12) * np.maximum(syy - sy ** 2 / np.maximum(n, 1), 1e-12))

"""Synthetic score matrices with known rank/noise and a misspecification ladder (C4, C6).
generate(...) returns standardised-scale scores for M models x N benchmarks plus the truth."""
import numpy as np

LEVELS = ["L0_correct", "L1_saturating_link", "L2_heavy_tails", "L3_heteroscedastic_ceiling", "L4_correlated_residuals"]

def loadings(N, r, regime, rng, snr=8.0):
    """regime 'separated': r factors with equal strength, eigenvalues >> noise; 'decaying': strength ~ i^-0.8 over `r` factors (r large)."""
    V = rng.standard_normal((N, r)) / np.sqrt(N)
    if regime == "separated":
        s = np.full(r, snr)
    else:
        s = snr * (np.arange(1, r + 1) ** -0.8) * 2.0
    V = V * s[None] * np.sqrt(1.0)
    return V

def generate(M, N, r, regime, level, seed, snr=8.0, noise_lo=0.3, noise_hi=1.0):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    V = loadings(N, r, regime, rng, snr=snr)
    # per-benchmark noise sd chosen so the total variance is ~ unit-scale multiples: psi_j in [noise_lo, noise_hi]^2 * mean signal var
    sig_var = (V ** 2).sum(1)
    psi = (rng.uniform(noise_lo, noise_hi, N) ** 2) * sig_var.mean() * 0.35
    z = rng.standard_normal((M, r)); mu = rng.standard_normal(N)
    signal = z @ V.T
    eps = rng.standard_normal((M, N)) * np.sqrt(psi)[None]
    if level == "L2_heavy_tails":
        eps = rng.standard_t(3, (M, N)) * np.sqrt(psi / 3.0)[None]          # t3 scaled to the same variance
    if level == "L3_heteroscedastic_ceiling":
        lat = signal + mu[None]; c = (lat - np.quantile(lat, 0.5, axis=0)) / (lat.std(0) + 1e-9)
        eps = eps * (1 + 1.5 * np.clip(c, 0, None))
    if level == "L4_correlated_residuals":
        n_cl = max(N // 12, 2); cl = rng.integers(0, n_cl, N)
        shared = rng.standard_normal((M, n_cl)) * np.sqrt(psi.mean() * 0.8)
        eps = eps * np.sqrt(0.5) + shared[:, cl]
    Y = mu[None] + signal + eps
    if level == "L1_saturating_link":
        sc = Y.std(0); Y = 2.5 * np.tanh(Y / (1.2 * sc[None] + 1e-9)) * sc[None]       # bounded, saturating link
    return dict(Y=Y, V=V, psi=psi, mu=mu)

def standardise_cols(Y, ref=None):
    ref = Y if ref is None else ref
    m, s = ref.mean(0), ref.std(0); return (Y - m) / s, m, s

```console
"""C4 synthetic checks: T1 (known params) vs measured, estimation term vs M, misspecification ladder, S6 vs S0.
usage: python 10_synth.py <out_dir> [quick]"""
import os, sys, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from fa import fit_fa, posterior_row, design_risk
from synth import *
import select_rules as SR

out = sys.argv[1]; quick = len(sys.argv) > 2
K = [1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, 20, 32]
N = 120; N_TEST = 150; DENS = 0.6; D = 20
SEEDS = range(3) if quick else range(8)
rows = []

def mask_like(M, N, rng, dens=DENS):
    """missingness with a heterogeneous per-model coverage (like the real matrix): per-model prob ~ Beta"""
    p = rng.beta(2.0, 2.0 * (1 - dens) / dens, size=(M, 1)); return rng.random((M, N)) < p

def eval_cfg(M, regime, level, r_true, seed, rank_fit):
    g = generate(M + N_TEST, N, r_true, regime, level, seed * 1000 + 17)
    Y = g["Y"]; Ytr, Yte = Y[:M], Y[M:]
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 5)
    msk = mask_like(M, N, rng); Ytr_m = np.where(msk, Ytr, np.nan)
    Ztr, m_, s_ = standardise_cols(Ytr_m, Ytr_m) if False else (None, None, None)
    mu = np.nanmean(Ytr_m, 0); sd = np.nanstd(Ytr_m, 0); Ztr = (Ytr_m - mu) / sd; Zte = (Yte - mu) / sd
    fit = fit_fa(Ztr, rank_fit)
    # truth on the standardised scale: only exact in the correct model, used for the known-parameter T1 curve
    tr_mu = (g["mu"] - mu) / sd; trV = g["V"] / sd[:, None]; trpsi = g["psi"] / sd ** 2
    truth = dict(mu=tr_mu, V=trV, psi=trpsi)
    res = []
    for k in K:
        errs = {"S6": [], "S0": []}; t1_true = []; t1_fit = []; e_floor = []
        for i in range(N_TEST):
            z = Zte[i]; cand = np.arange(N)
            S6 = SR.s6_greedy(fit, cand, k)
            sets = {"S6": [S6], "S0": [rng.choice(N, k, replace=False) for _ in range(D)]}
            for rule, ss in sets.items():
                e = []
                for S in ss:
                    T = np.setdiff1d(cand, S)
                    zz, _ = posterior_row(fit, S, z[S]); pred = fit["mu"][T] + fit["V"][T] @ zz
                    e.append(np.mean((pred - z[T]) ** 2) )
                errs[rule].append(np.mean(e))
            T = np.setdiff1d(cand, S6)
            t1_fit.append(np.mean(design_risk(fit, S6)[T])); t1_true.append(np.mean(design_risk(truth, S6)[T])) 
            # measured error of the *true-parameter* posterior with the same S6 (isolates the estimation term)
            zt, _ = posterior_row(truth, S6, z[S6]); pt = truth["mu"][T] + truth["V"][T] @ zt; e_floor.append(np.mean((pt - z[T]) ** 2))
        res.append(dict(M=M, regime=regime, level=level, seed=seed, k=k, rank_fit=rank_fit, mse_S6=np.mean(errs["S6"]), mse_S0=np.mean(errs["S0"]),
                        t1_true=np.mean(t1_true), t1_fit=np.mean(t1_fit), mse_trueparams_S6=np.mean(e_floor)))
    return res

def run(M, regime, level, r_true, rank_fit, label):
    for s in SEEDS:
        rows.extend(eval_cfg(M, regime, level, r_true, s, rank_fit))
        print(label, M, s, flush=True)

for M in ([60, 120, 240] if quick else [40, 80, 160, 320, 640]):
    run(M, "separated", "L0_correct", 6, 6, "sep")
run(240 if not quick else 120, "decaying", "L0_correct", 40, 8, "dec")
for lv in LEVELS[1:]:
    run(240 if not quick else 120, "separated", lv, 6, 6, lv)
df = pd.DataFrame(rows); os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
df.to_csv(os.path.join(out, "synth_raw.csv"), index=False)
print(df.groupby(["regime", "level", "M", "k"])[["mse_S6", "mse_S0", "t1_true", "t1_fit", "mse_trueparams_S6"]].mean().round(3).head(40))
```

"""Stage B: evaluate selection x inference rules on the held-out models of one (split, fold).
usage: python 05_eval.py <data_dir> <work_dir> <split> <fold> <out_dir> [rules comma list]
Output: <out_dir>/<split>_<fold>_<tag>.parquet, one row per (model, k, rule, inference, draw)."""
import os, sys, pickle, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from common import *
from fa import complete, predict_row, design_risk
from state import loo_predictions
import select_rules as SR, infer_rules as IR

def metrics(pred, z, sd, T, e_loo_raw, delta, gap, floorj):
    err = (pred[T] - z[T]); raw = err * sd[T]
    row = dict(n_targets=len(T), rmse_raw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(raw ** 2))), mae_raw=float(np.mean(np.abs(raw))),
               rmse_std=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(err ** 2))), floor_raw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(e_loo_raw[T] ** 2))),
               delta_mean=float(np.nanmean(delta[T])), floorj_mean=float(np.nanmean(floorj[T])), gap_mean=float(np.nanmean(gap[T])))
    if len(T) >= 3 and np.ptp(pred[T]) > 0:
        row["spearman"] = float(spearmanr(pred[T], z[T])[0])
    else:
        row["spearman"] = np.nan
    return row

def main():
    data_dir, work, split, fold, out = sys.argv[1:6]; fold = int(fold)
    rules = sys.argv[6].split(",") if len(sys.argv) > 6 else ["S0", "S6"]
    tag = sys.argv[7] if len(sys.argv) > 7 else "main"
    Y, mods, tasks, et = load_matrix(data_dir)
    st = pickle.load(open(os.path.join(work, "state", f"{split}_{fold}.pkl"), "rb"))
    train, test, mu, sd = st["train"], st["test"], st["mu"], st["sd"]
    Z = (Y - mu) / sd; mask = ~np.isnan(Y)
    Ztr = Z[train]; N = Y.shape[1]
    cover = mask[train].sum(0).astype(float); rawsd = sd
    cost = np.nanmedian(et[train], 0); cost = np.where(np.isnan(cost), np.nanmedian(cost), cost)
    rows = []; t0 = time.time()
    need_completed = {r for r in rules if r in ("S4", "S5")}
    Xc = {}
    for r, fit in st["fits"].items():
        if need_completed: Xc[r] = complete(Ztr, fit)
    for m in test:
        obs = np.where(mask[m])[0]; z = Z[m]
        floor_fit = st["fits"][st["best_rank"]["loo"]]
        e_loo = np.zeros(N); e_loo[obs] = (loo_predictions(floor_fit, obs, z[obs]) - z[obs]) * sd[obs]   # raw points
        rng_m = np.random.default_rng(SEED * 31 + int(m))
        for k in K_GRID:
            if len(obs) <= k: continue
            r = st["best_rank"][k]; fit = st["fits"][r]
            for rule in rules:
                if rule == "S0": sets = [SR.s0_random(obs, k, rng_m) for _ in range(D_RANDOM)]
                elif rule == "S1": sets = [SR.s1_popular(obs, k, cover)]
                elif rule == "S2": sets = [SR.s2_variance(obs, k, rawsd)]
                elif rule == "S6": sets = [SR.s6_greedy(fit, obs, k)]
                elif rule == "S6u": sets = [SR.s6_unrun(fit, obs, k)]                     # target = benchmarks not yet run
                elif rule == "S6r": sets = [SR.s6_greedy(fit, obs, k, target=obs)]      # own-run-set target variant
                elif rule == "S6c": sets = [SR.s6_greedy(fit, obs, k, cost=cost)]       # cost-aware (gain per unit cost)
                elif rule == "S4": sets = [SR.s4_pivqr(Xc[r], obs, k)]
                elif rule == "S5": sets = [SR.s5_cluster(Xc[r], obs, k, rng_m)]
                else: raise ValueError(rule)
                for d, S in enumerate(sets):
                    S = np.asarray(S); T = np.setdiff1d(obs, S)
                    base = dict(split=split, fold=fold, model=int(m), k=k, rule=rule, draw=d, rank=r, runset=len(obs),
                                cost_sel=float(cost[S].sum()))
                    # T1 prediction (known-parameter risk under the fitted model) for the same S and targets, raw points
                    dr = design_risk(fit, S); base["t1_rmse_raw"] = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(dr[T] * sd[T] ** 2)))
                    base["t1_floor_raw"] = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(fit["psi"][T] * sd[T] ** 2)))

"""Per-fold state (stage A): standardisation, FA fits for all ranks on the training models, inner group-CV rank choice
per reveal size, all-others floors and margins (PREREG sections F, G). Saved to pickle for the evaluation stage."""
import os, sys, pickle, numpy as np, pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from common import *
from fa import fit_fa, posterior_row

def loo_predictions(fit, idx, y):
    """leave-one-benchmark-out predictions (standardised) for every observed cell of one row, via a rank-1 downdate."""
    V, mu, psi = fit["V"], fit["mu"], fit["psi"]; r = V.shape[1]
    A = V[idx] / np.sqrt(psi[idx])[:, None]; e = (y - mu[idx]) / np.sqrt(psi[idx])
    P = np.eye(r) + A.T @ A; C = np.linalg.inv(P); b = A.T @ e
    Ca = A @ C                                   # n x r  (C a_j)
    q = np.einsum("jr,jr->j", Ca, A)             # a_j' C a_j
    bj = b[None] - A * e[:, None]
    # exact Sherman-Morrison: P_j^{-1} bj = C bj + C a (a' C bj)/(1 - a'Ca)
    Cb = bj @ C                                   # C symmetric
    z = Cb + Ca * (np.einsum("jr,jr->j", A, Cb) / (1 - q))[:, None]
    return mu[idx] + np.einsum("jr,jr->j", V[idx], z)

def inner_scores(Ztr, groups_tr, ranks, k_list, rng, n_draws=2):
    """inner group-CV squared error (standardised) for each (rank, reveal) where reveal in k_list or 'loo'.
    Also returns per-task LOO squared errors (standardised) for floors, per rank."""
    n = Ztr.shape[0]; fo = inner_group_folds(groups_tr)
    mask = ~np.isnan(Ztr)
    score = {(r, k): [] for r in ranks for k in k_list + ["loo"]}
    loo_err = {r: [[] for _ in range(Ztr.shape[1])] for r in ranks}
    for f in np.unique(fo):
        tr = np.where(fo != f)[0]; va = np.where(fo == f)[0]
        for r in ranks:
            fit = fit_fa(Ztr[tr], r)
            for m in va:
                obs = np.where(mask[m])[0]
                if len(obs) < 2: continue
                yv = Ztr[m]
                for k in k_list:
                    for _ in range(n_draws):
                        S = rng.choice(obs, min(k, len(obs) - 1), replace=False)
                        T = np.setdiff1d(obs, S)

                        pred = fit["mu"][T] + fit["V"][T] @ z
                        score[(r, k)].append(np.mean((pred - yv[T]) ** 2))

                score[(r, "loo")].append(er.mean())

    avg = {key: float(np.mean(v)) for key, v in score.items()}
    return avg, loo_err

    rl = best_rank["loo"]

# Code: which benchmarks to run for a new model, and how many

Reproduces every number, table and figure input of the paper from the pinned MTEB results. Pre-registration: `../prereg/PREREG.md`
(append-only; deviations are listed at its end). Result files: `../results/`. Matrix (derived, small): `../data/`.

## Environment
CPU only. Python 3.11.2; numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, pandas 3.0.6, pyarrow 26.0.0, scikit-learn 1.9.1, matplotlib 3.11.2, torch 2.14.1+cpu
(see `requirements.lock`; torch is used by no script that produces a reported number — all models are numpy/scipy). Step 2 additionally
needs `mteb==2.27.24` (task metadata only; no score is read from it). All BLAS work is single-threaded (`OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`) and
jobs are parallelised by (split, fold); results do not depend on the thread count. Global seed `20261126` (`common.SEED`); every
derived seed is a function of it, of the split/fold and of the model index (no use of Python's `hash`).

## Data
```
git clone https://github.com/embeddings-benchmark/results mteb_results   # CC0-1.0, ~0.6 GB history
git -C mteb_results checkout 6dabbcc68c28ea5f180ce7df79347b3ca9cc6383
```
(raw results are not stored in this repository; `data/` holds the derived matrix: `matrix_long.parquet` (model, task, score, eval_time),
`models.csv` (org group, release date, run-set size), `tasks.csv` (task type, n_models), `coverage_filter.csv` (Table 1), `matrix_summary.json`.)

## Pipeline (W = scratch dir, D = `data/`, R = result dir of the stage-B parquet files, `results/` = delivered result files)
| step | command | what it does | output | ~time (4 cpus) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `python code/01_extract.py mteb_results/results $W` | flatten raw tree to cells | `$W/cells_raw.parquet`, `model_meta.parquet` | 3 min |
| 2 | `python code/02_taskmeta.py $W` | task type/splits from `mteb` (metadata only) | `$W/task_meta.parquet` | 1 min |
| 3 | `python code/03_build_matrix.py $W data` | rules R1–R7 of PREREG B: one revision per model, dedup, org groups, coverage filter | `data/*` (238 models x 328 tasks, 45,775 cells) | <1 min |
| 4 | `bash code/04_states.sh data $W` | stage A per fold: standardisation, factor-analysis fits for all ranks, inner group-CV rank choice per k, all-others floors, margins delta | `$W/state/{G_0..G_9,T_0,S_0}.pkl` | 5 min |
| 5 | `python code/06_delta_table.py $W prereg/delta_by_fold.csv` | collects margins (committed before any contrast) | `prereg/delta_by_fold.csv` | <1 min |
| 6 | `bash code/07_eval_all.sh data $W $R` | stage B: rules S0,S1,S2,S4,S5,S6,S6r,S6c x P5/P1/P0 (`05_eval.py`) | `$R/*_main.parquet` | 20 min |
| 7 | `bash code/12_extra_all.sh data $W $R` | stage A2/B2: baseline tuning (`state2.py`, `baselines.py`), S3 wrapper, S7 interview, S6u, P2–P6 grid (`05b_eval_extra.py`) | `$R/*_extra.parquet`, `$W/state/*_b.pkl` | 1–2 h |
| 8 | `python code/08_aggregate.py data $R results` | curves with group-bootstrap CI, contrast S6 vs S0 and verdicts, empirical vs predicted k*, Table 1 | `results/curves.csv`, `contrast_S6_vs_S0.csv`, `kstar.csv`, `excess_curve_*.csv`, `table1_*` | 5 min |
| 9 | `python code/09_structure.py data $W results` | spectrum, three rank estimators, CV-vs-rank, coverage | `results/fig2_*` | 3 min |
| 10 | `python code/17_theory.py data $R results` | T1 prediction vs measurement and misfit decomposition (real data) | `results/fig3_decomposition.csv` | <1 min |
| 11 | `bash code/14_cells_all.sh data $W $W/cells` | per task-type / per-task error accounting (Table 3) | `$W/cells/*.parquet` | 20 min |
| 12 | `bash code/16_scope_all.sh data $W/scope` | scope sweeps: training size M, missing rate, logit transform, task-type granularity (`15_scope.py`) | `$W/scope/*.parquet` | 1 h |
| 13 | `python code/10_synth.py $W/synth` | synthetic study: known-parameter T1 check, estimation term vs M, misspecification ladder (`synth.py`) | `$W/synth/synth_raw.csv` | 1–2 h |
| 14 | `python code/11_unit_t3.py results/unit_t3.json` | unit test of the adaptivity cl

T split: k* 5 vs predicted 3; S split: 8 vs 5. T1 predicts 5.7 RMSE at k=20 where 6.3 is measured. The theory is optimistic: the gap is the misfit term (Fig. 3), see results/fig3_decomposition.csv: at k=20, measured MSE 44.8 = noise 30.6 + noise misfit 1.0 + design 2.1 + estimation misfit 11.0 (CI 7.9-14.1). """Greedy vs exhaustive (k=2,3) and vs greedy+1-swap local search (k=8,20) for the S6 objective F(S)=tr(V' V Sigma(S)),
Sigma(S)=(I+sum_{j in S} a_j a_j')^-1, a_j=v_j/sqrt(psi_j). Held-out models of G fold 0 (all models with run set > 3). Also the
measured RMSE (P5, raw points) of the refined design vs greedy, to see whether the objective gap matters.
usage: python 19_greedy_check.py <data_dir> <work_dir> <out_csv> [n_models]"""
import os, sys, pickle, itertools, numpy as np, pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from common import *
import select_rules as SR, infer_rules as IR
data_dir, work, out = sys.argv[1:4]; nm = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 40
Y, mods, tasks, et = load_matrix(data_dir)
st = pickle.load(open(os.path.join(work, "state", "G_0.pkl"), "rb")); mu, sd = st["mu"], st["sd"]; Z = (Y - mu) / sd; mask = ~np.isnan(Y)
rng = np.random.default_rng(1); test = [m for m in st["test"] if mask[m].sum() > 20]; test = list(rng.choice(test, min(nm, len(test)), replace=False))
def F(G, A, S):
    r = A.shape[1]; P = np.eye(r) + A[S].T @ A[S]; return float(np.trace(G @ np.linalg.inv(P)))
rows = []
for m in test:
    obs = np.where(mask[m])[0]; z = Z[m]
    for k in (2, 3, 8, 20):
        fit = st["fits"][st["best_rank"][k]]; V, psi = fit["V"], fit["psi"]; G = V.T @ V; A = V[obs] / np.sqrt(psi[obs])[:, None]
        g = SR.s6_greedy(fit, obs, k); gi = [int(np.where(obs == j)[0][0]) for j in g]; Fg = F(G, A, gi)
        if k <= 3:
            best = (np.inf, None)
            combos = np.array(list(itertools.combinations(range(len(obs)), k)))
            for ch in np.array_split(combos, max(1, len(combos) // 20000)):
                P = np.eye(A.shape[1])[None] + np.einsum("cki,ckj->cij", A[ch], A[ch]); Fv = np.einsum("ij,cji->c", G, np.linalg.inv(P))
                i = int(np.argmin(Fv))
                if Fv[i] < best[0]: best = (Fv[i], ch[i])
            Fr, Sr = best[0], list(best[1]); kind = "exhaustive"
        else:
            Sr = list(gi); Fr = Fg; improved = True
            while improved:
                improved = False
                for pos in range(k):
                    for j in range(len(obs)):
                        if j in Sr: continue
                        T = Sr.copy(); T[pos] = j; f = F(G, A, T)
                        if f < Fr - 1e-9: Sr, Fr, improved = T, f, True
            kind = "swap"
        def rmse(Sidx):
            S = obs[np.array(Sidx)]; T = np.setdiff1d(obs, S); p = IR.p5_fa(fit, S, z[S]); return float(np.sqrt(np.mean(((p[T] - z[T]) * sd[T]) ** 2)))
        rows.append(dict(model=int(m), k=k, kind=kind, F_greedy=Fg, F_refined=Fr, rel_gap=(Fg - Fr) / Fg, same_set=set(gi) == set(Sr), rmse_greedy=rmse(gi), rmse_refined=rmse(Sr)))
    print(m, flush=True)
df = pd.DataFrame(rows); df.to_csv(out, index=False)
print(df.groupby(["k", "kind"]).agg(rel_gap_mean=("rel_gap", "mean"), rel_gap_max=("rel_gap", "max"), frac_same=("same_set", "mean"), rmse_greedy=("rmse_greedy", "mean"), rmse_refined=("rmse_refined", "mean")).round(4))
EOF

def s6_swap(fit, cand, k, max_pass=10):
    """S6s: greedy start (s6_greedy), then single-swap local search on the same objective F(S)=tr(V'V Sigma(S)):
    for each position remove its item (rank-1 downdate of the posterior precision) and re-pick the best item among all
    candidates not in the rest of the set (Sherman-Morrison gains); repeat until no swap improves F (or max_pass passes)."""
    V, psi = fit["V"], fit["psi"]; r = V.shape[1]
    G = V.T @ V; A = V[cand] / np.sqrt(psi[cand])[:, None]
    S = [int(np.where(cand == j)[0][0]) for j in s6_greedy(fit, cand, k)]
    def Fval(S):
        P = np.eye(r) + A[S].T @ A[S]; return float(np.trace(G @ np.linalg.inv(P)))
    cur = Fval(S)
    for _ in range(max_pass):
        changed = False
        for pos in range(len(S)):
            rest = S[:pos] + S[pos + 1:]
            Sig = np.linalg.inv(np.eye(r) + A[rest].T @ A[rest]) if rest else np.eye(r)
            SA = A @ Sig; den = 1.0 + np.einsum("jr,jr->j", SA, A)
            gain = np.einsum("jr,jr->j", SA @ G, SA) / den
            gain[rest] = -np.inf
            j = int(np.argmax(gain)); new = rest[:pos] + [j] + rest[pos:]
            f = Fval(new)
            if f < cur - 1e-9: S, cur, changed = new, f, True
        if not changed: break
    return cand[np.array(S)]

One row per model dir (org/name): the latest-dated result file that has the full subtask set; cells = per-subtask main metric
(acc_norm for BBH/GPQA/MuSR, exact_match for MATH-hard subjects, prompt_level_strict_acc for IFEval, acc for MMLU-Pro), x100.
usage: python olb_extract.py <results_dir> <out_dir>"""
import os, sys, json, glob, re
import pandas as pd
root, out = sys.argv[1:3]; os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
METRIC = [("leaderboard_bbh_", "acc_norm,none"), ("leaderboard_gpqa_", "acc_norm,none"), ("leaderboard_math_", "exact_match,none"),
          ("leaderboard_musr_", "acc_norm,none")]
rows = []
files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "*", "*", "results_*.json")))

    rows.append(dict(model=model, stamp=stamp, n_cells=len(cells), **cells))

"""Build the Open LLM Leaderboard per-subtask matrix in the same long format as the MTEB matrix (data_olb/).
Models: latest full (39-subtask) result file per model dir. Groups ("family stem"): a model-name keyword list for the
base families that dominate the leaderboard (merges and fine-tunes of one base share a stem across uploader orgs); a model that
matches no keyword falls back to its uploader org. Release date proxy = evaluation timestamp of the file.
usage: python olb_matrix.py <out_dir_of_olb_extract> <data_dir>"""
import os, sys, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
src, out = sys.argv[1:3]; os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
d = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(src, "olb_files.parquet"))
full = d[d.n_cells == 39].sort_values("stamp").groupby("model").tail(1).reset_index(drop=True)
cols = [c for c in full.columns if c.startswith("leaderboard")]
FAM = ["qwen3", "qwen2.5", "qwen2", "qwen1.5", "qwen", "llama-3.3", "llama-3.2", "llama-3.1", "llama-3", "llama3", "llama-2", "llama2", "llama", "mistral-nemo", "mistral",
       "mixtral", "gemma-3", "gemma-2", "gemma2", "gemma", "phi-4", "phi-3", "phi", "yi-", "yi1.5", "deepseek", "falcon", "internlm", "olmo", "smollm", "solar", "command-r",
       "nemotron", "glm", "starling", "zephyr", "openchat", "vicuna", "tinyllama", "pythia", "gpt-neo", "opt-", "bloom", "stablelm", "granite", "minicpm", "aya", "exaone", "t5", "mpt-"]
def fam(m):
    org, name = m.split("/", 1); n = name.lower()
    for f in FAM:
        if f in n: return "fam:" + f.strip("-")
    return "org:" + org
full["org"] = full.model.map(fam); full["uploader"] = full.model.str.split("/").str[0]
full["release_date"] = pd.to_datetime(full.stamp.str.replace(r"T(\d\d)-(\d\d)-(\d\d).*", r"T\1:\2:\3", regex=True), errors="coerce").dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
full["runset"] = len(cols)
long = full.melt(id_vars=["model"], value_vars=cols, var_name="task", value_name="score").dropna()
long["eval_time"] = np.nan
long.to_parquet(os.path.join(out, "matrix_long.parquet"))
full[["model", "org", "uploader", "release_date", "runset"]].to_csv(os.path.join(out, "models.csv"), index=False)
ty = lambda t: ("bbh" if "_bbh_" in t else "gpqa" if "_gpqa_" in t else "math" if "_math_" in t else "musr" if "_musr_" in t else "ifeval" if "ifeval" in t else "mmlu_pro")
pd.DataFrame(dict(task=cols, type=[ty(c) for c in cols], n_models=len(full))).to_csv(os.path.join(out, "tasks.csv"), index=False)
print(len(full), len(cols), full.org.nunique(), full.org.value_counts().head(8).to_dict(), "largest group share", round(full.org.value_counts().iloc[0] / len(full), 3))
